No. 12101); 22 U.S.C. 254c (jobs/theophilus-sources/output/texts/usc-t22-s254c.txt, current text, section 4 of the Diplomatic Relations Act) and 3 U.S.C. 301 (usc-t3-s301.txt) remain in the Code; no eCFR or OFR-catalog ending found through 2026-10-14.
clauses.reason: The clause delegates to the Secretary of State the President's functions under section 4 of the Diplomatic Relations Act (22 U.S.C. 254c), originally together with section 6 (22 U.S.C. 254e). EO 12608 sec. 29 (1987-09-09) struck the words for sections 4 and 6 and inserted section 4 alone: the clause continues amended and the section 6 part ended on that date. The Code note under 22 U.S.C. 254c prints the order in the amended form and 22 U.S.C. 254c is in the held current Code.

research_rationale:
Identity: Executive Order 12101 of November 17, 1978, 43 FR 54195, held at jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_12101.txt (FR Doc. 78-32799); it designates and empowers the Secretary of State to perform, without presidential action, the functions vested in the President by sections 4 and 6 of the Diplomatic Relations Act (22 U.S.C. 254c and 254e). Later instrument: EO 12608 sec. 29 (signed Sept. 9, 1987; no separate effective-date clause in its text) deleted the words for sections 4 and 6 and inserted section 4 of the Diplomatic Relations Act (22 U.S.C. 254c), so the delegation as amended covers only section 4; the section 6 function (22 U.S.C. 254e) left the order on that date (OFR note: amended by EO 12608). Searches of held texts find only EO 12608 and the 1989 OFR codification line. Bounded searches read for coverage: current-law:usc (U.S. Code release point 119-121 USLM text and notes, citations of the order by number, edition current through 2026-10-09, laws enacted 2026-10-10 to 2026-10-14 not reflected), current-law:ecfr (eCFR point-in-time search as of 2026-10-14 plus GovInfo CFR bulk XML, 49 titles) and later-events:ofr_catalog (Office of the Federal Register disposition notes of 6941 catalog records plus operative sentences in 17521 saved order texts).
